rows.title: Opening run follows the Design Release 2.1 step order and ends on the review page
rows.detail: A trader starting a new notification is carried through the pages in Design Release 2.1's order: the reason for import is asked straight after what is being imported and before commodity details, the CPH number page is no longer a step after roles and addresses (it is reached only from its row there), roles and addresses goes on to the contact address unless everything is already complete, and the contact address always goes on to the review page, which names anything still outstanding. The tests repo's full journey is rewritten as Design Release 2.1's cattle-by-air journey in the new order, because today's cattle-by-road walk follows the old order and would break.
acceptanceCriteria: In a new notification's opening run, 'Save and continue' on 'What are you importing?' goes to 'Main reason for import', and 'Save and continue' on 'Main reason for import' goes to 'Commodity details'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1495-1501; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-180)

In the opening run, 'Save and continue' on 'Commodity details' goes to 'Identification details' when a chosen commodity needs animal identifiers, and otherwise to 'Additional details'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1495-1501; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-180)

In the opening run, 'Save and continue' on 'Roles and addresses' goes to 'Contact address for this consignment', including for a consignment that needs a CPH number; the run never shows the CPH number page. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1495-1534)

The CPH number page opens only from its row on 'Roles and addresses', and saving it returns to 'Roles and addresses'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1495-1534; repo:tests tests/animals/e2e/features/cph-scope.spec.ts:56-64)

When every section on the overview is already complete, 'Save and continue' on 'Roles and addresses' goes to the overview instead of the contact address page. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1545-1547)

'Save and continue' on 'Contact address for this consignment' at the end of the opening run goes to the review page even when the notification is incomplete, and the review page names what is outstanding. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1523-1527, 1536-1554; prototype:dr2-1-specs COVERAGE.md:163-164)

The tests repo walks a cattle-by-air notification from create to 'Import notification submitted' in this order: origin of the import with a region code and an internal reference, 'What are you importing?' with cattle (Bos taurus), 'Main reason for import' (Internal market, Breeding), 'Commodity details' for 2 animals, 'Identification details' with an ear tag and passport for each animal, 'Additional details' with the unweaned question answered, arrival details by air, transporter, documents, 'Roles and addresses' with a CPH number, contact address, review, declaration. In that walk, every task on the overview reads 'Complete' before the review is opened, and the review shows the origin with its region code, the internal reference, Bos taurus, Breeding, the purpose given, the CPH number and the chosen transporter. rows.title: A page opened from an overview task returns to the overview when saved
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 sends a trader who opens a page from its task on the overview back to the overview on 'Save and continue', rather than on through the rest of the page's flow section. The service tells such a page by its own journey state, not by a marker in the page address: any save made outside the opening run and outside a change from the review page returns to the overview. Every page the journey chains to today has its own row on the overview, so nothing becomes unreachable.
acceptanceCriteria: Opened from its overview task, 'What are you importing?' goes to the overview on 'Save and continue', not to 'Commodity details'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1588-1602; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-196 to p1-198)

Opened from its overview task, 'Main reason for import' goes to the overview on 'Save and continue', not to 'Additional details'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1588-1602; trace:animals-fit p1-058 to p1-063)

Opened from its overview task, 'Arrival details' goes to the overview on 'Save and continue', not to 'Transit countries' or the transporter page. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1588-1602; trace:e2e p14-091)

Opened from its overview task, 'Roles and addresses' goes to the overview on 'Save and continue', not to the CPH number page, including for a consignment that needs a CPH number. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1588-1602; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-015)

'Commodity details', 'Additional details', 'Transit countries' and the transporter page each open from their own overview row and return to the overview on 'Save and continue'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1588-1602)

rows.title: 'Save and return to overview' saves without the page's required-answer checks
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 lets a trader leave most pages for the overview without finishing them, so they can come back later. The backend already stores missing or empty answers. An answer that breaks its own format rule is still refused, because the service cannot store a value that does not fit its field, and consignment details, the CPH number page and the contact address page keep checking their answers before saving.
acceptanceCriteria: On origin of the import, 'What are you importing?', 'Main reason for import', 'Identification details', 'Additional details', 'Arrival details', 'Transit countries', the transporter page, 'Upload documents' and 'Roles and addresses', pressing 'Save and return to overview' with a required answer missing shows no error, saves what was entered and goes to the overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1560-1566, p1-068)
After such a save the page's overview task does not read 'Complete', and reopening the page shows the answers that were entered. (prototype:dr2-1-specs COVERAGE.md:163-164)

An answer that fails its own format rule, such as an impossible arrival date or a malformed region code, is refused on 'Save and return to overview' with that answer's error, and the page is not saved. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claim 10)

On 'Commodity details' and 'Contact address for this consignment', 'Save and return to overview' with a required answer missing shows the page's errors and saves nothing. (prototype:dr2-1-specs COVERAGE.md:162)

rows.title: Hard stops: means of transport on arrival details and number of packages on commodity details
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 makes the means of transport the only hard stop on 'Arrival details', because it decides whether transit countries apply; the other arrival answers can be left for later. On commodity details the number of packages becomes a hard stop, alongside the number of animals, on each line that asks for it.
acceptanceCriteria: On 'Arrival details', 'Save and continue' with no means of transport chosen is refused with an error on the means of transport question. (prototype:dr2-1-specs COVERAGE.md:162, p7-129)

On 'Arrival details', 'Save and continue' with a means of transport chosen and the arrival date, port of entry, transport identification and transport document reference blank goes on to the next page. (prototype:dr2-1-specs COVERAGE.md:158, p7-140)

On 'Commodity details', 'Save and continue' with a line that asks for a number of packages left without one is refused with an error on that line's number of packages. (prototype:dr2-1-specs COVERAGE.md:162, p7-139)

On 'Commodity details', a line that does not ask for a number of packages can be saved without one. (prototype:dr2-1-specs COVERAGE.md:162; repo:frontend obligations/sections/commodities/lines.js:4-8)

rows.title: Back links follow the context a page was opened in
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 builds every journey page's Back link from how the page was reached: to the overview from an overview task, to the template's review page from a template review, and otherwise to the previous page in the step order, including when the page was opened from the review page's Change link. The context comes from the service's own journey state (the opening run, ?change=1, template editing), not from a from=hub or from=review marker. Today task pages point Back at the overview whatever context they were opened in.
acceptanceCriteria: A page opened from its overview task has a 'Back' link to the overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:488-498, p1-052)

A page reached by 'Save and continue' in the opening run has a 'Back' link to the previous page in the step order: 'Main reason for import' goes back to 'What are you importing?', and 'Commodity details' goes back to 'Main reason for import'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:488-498, 1495-1501)

A page opened from a Change link on the review page has a 'Back' link to the previous page in the step order, not to the review page; 'Save and continue' there still returns to the review page. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:488-498, p1-053; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-089)
A page opened from a template's review page has a 'Back' link to that template's review page. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:488-498)

Pages behind 'Roles and addresses' (the party pickers and the CPH number page) keep their 'Back' link to 'Roles and addresses'. (repo:tests tests/animals/e2e/features/cph-scope.spec.ts:66-73; trace:animals-fit p1-047)

rows.title: Each set opens only its own category's notifications
rows.detail: Sam's 9 October ruling keeps one category per set: a germinal products notification can only be worked in the germinal set, and a live-animals notification only in the live-animals set. Each set's entry guard reads the category recorded on the notification when its draft was created, and a notification with no recorded category is treated as live animals.

A notification stored with no category opens in the live-animals set and shows the page not found page in the germinal products set. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-029, p1-030)
